title: Does Hot Weather Raise Your Blood Pressure? What Adults Over 40 Need to Know
description: Heat causes blood vessels to dilate—yet 68% of adults over 45 see BP spikes during heat waves. Learn how to monitor, hydrate, and stay safe this summer.
reasoning: A dangerous misconception is spreading: many believe heat always lowers BP, but real-world data shows summer heat waves trigger hypertensive crises in midlife+ adults—especially with dehydration or medication interactions. Users want actionable, age-specific guidance—not textbook physiology.
